summary: Surface that groups content and actions about a single subject.
whenToUse: Groups of KPIs or content in a grid.
whenNotToUse: To frame every section of the page: use Section.
For comparable tabular data: use Table or DataTable.

props.name: as
props.description: Semantic element; use li inside a list.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface emphasis. accent uses a two-tone frame (brand → tertiary gradient) for featured content; in forced-colors mode it becomes a system border.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Selected state (border and data-selected). Does not replace a control with an accessible state.

props.name: CardHeader.title / subtitle / media / actions
props.description: Header with title (heading), subtitle, leading media, and actions.

props.name: CardHeader.headingLevel
props.description: Heading level that matches the page hierarchy.

props.name: CardLink
props.description: Link whose clickable area extends to the whole card (stretched link).

inherits: HTML attributes of the rendered element; ref is forwarded.

keyboard.action: Reaches the links and buttons inside; the card itself is not focusable.

accessibility: With CardLink the whole card is clickable, but there is a single link with a clear name (the title).
Other interactive controls in a card with CardLink stay above the link layer and remain clickable.
Choose a headingLevel consistent with the page structure.
responsive: Fluid width: the container grid decides the columns.
Footer actions wrap on narrow viewports.
commonMistakes: Wrapping the whole card in an <a> with buttons inside: nested interactive elements are invalid.
Using isSelected without a control (button, checkbox) that conveys the state.
